justification: `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/description/method/MethodDescription.java` lines 1375-1641 show `Latent` with 9 state fields, 2 constructors, and many accessors/attachment methods for type variables, return type, parameters, exceptions, annotations, name, declaring type, modifiers, default value, and receiver type; it also contains the nested `TypeInitializer` subclass with its own separate behavior and 9 methods.
